description: Labelled paraphrase pairs for the forget guard (match_forgotten) and the explicit-mode write gate (decide_write). label=true: forget -> must NOT be stored (restates the forgotten entry); gate -> explicit remember must NOT store (duplicate of existing). cos = Harrier cosine (onnx-community/harrier-oss-v1-270m-ONNX, model_q4.onnx, via totalreclaw.embedding.get_embedding). Tests feed 2-d unit vectors [1,0] vs [cos, sqrt(1-cos^2)].
